title: Nuclear Energy
subtitle: Harnessing the Power of Atomic Nuclei

slides.title: Introduction to Nuclear Energy
paragraphs: Nuclear energy is a form of energy released from the nucleus, the core of atoms. It can be produced through fission or fusion reactions.
bullets: Key term: Nuclear Energy - what it means

slides.title: Current Situation in Nuclear Energy
paragraphs: Currently, the majority of electricity from nuclear power is produced by fission reactions.
bullets: 28 U.S. states powered by nuclear energy

slides.title: Applications of Nuclear Energy
bullets: Medical applications: cancer treatment and diagnosis

slides.title: Benefits and Challenges of Nuclear Energy
paragraphs: Nuclear energy has both benefits and challenges.

slides.title: Future Scope of Nuclear Energy
paragraphs: Emerging trends in nuclear energy include the development of new reactor designs and the use of advanced materials.
bullets: Expected: increased adoption of small modular reactors
Projected: improved efficiency through advanced materials

slides.title: Conclusion
bullets: Key takeaway: nuclear energy is a significant source of electricity
Recommendation: continued investment in nuclear research and development
